entries.reason: fix: add single-use exact-CAS recovery for a failed flow outbox entry
entries.trigger: The report outbox was already failed at attempt 2 before the dispatcher context propagation repair. Generic begin would increment it to attempt 3, so exact recovery required binding the approved failed entry by idempotency key, attempt, and failure without weakening normal retry behavior.
entries.resolution: Added immutable FlowOutboxRecoveryClaim and reopenFailedExact methods on FlowOutbox and FlowOutboxStore. Recovery succeeds only when status=failed and identity, attempt, and failure all match inside the atomic flow mutation; it preserves identity, attempt, and startedAt while reopening pending. Second use, foreign identity, attempt mismatch, and failure mismatch reject without changing any entry. Injected atomic write failure preserves old flow.json bytes. RED 10/14 SHA256 10af2abc993266250a9cf4168663f3309953be9db082c48815f888f0799038db; focused GREEN 14/14 SHA256 061d37b05fd634122ae0c75b0911f1ba378b670144ad43e81b596f21a6769bf4; related GREEN 3/3 files SHA256 f1def6d8dcf0d62d14cdcee64d5b97ac8cc42bb6c34fb0435e63b691c7928235. Generic retry, fallback, default, guards, and error policy are unchanged.

entries.reason: fix: persist a consumed receipt to prevent exact-recovery ABA reuse
entries.trigger: The first exact-CAS implementation could reopen a failed entry, then accept the same claim again if the reopened attempt failed with the same error, recreating the original status/attempt/failure tuple.
entries.resolution: FlowOutboxEntry now persists an immutable exactRecoveryReceipt containing the recovered idempotency key, attempt, and failure. The receipt is created atomically with reopen and retained across fail, retry, touch, and complete transitions. Exact recovery checks failed status and then rejects every entry carrying a receipt, preventing claim reuse after ABA while retaining exact claim binding, foreign-entry immutability, and atomic write failure behavior. RED 14/15 SHA256 4e1491f200f73ebfdb693940d095882217450355cab1113f3bfc68a48bebe2e1; focused GREEN 15/15 SHA256 8441ded03ea8cc91b0aa94839d086388c55c18d098074c9d847c760e21ab79c0; related GREEN 3/3 files SHA256 71c10841fdc0603276e271335c50a17540e0aa0db35f4097c93cbbc42d1d04d1. Generic retry, implicit recovery defaults, guards, and error policy are unchanged.
